description: This source file defines the 'ServeCommand' structure implementing a CLI command for running the Swabble service in the foreground, handling configuration, speech streaming, wake word detection, logging, and executing associated jobs.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line interface (CLI) command that runs the Swabble application, handling configuration, speech recognition streaming, wake word detection, job execution, and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: The main asynchronous method that loads configuration, initializes the speech pipeline, processes speech segments, detects wake words, executes hook jobs, and logs information.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: A private static method that checks whether a given text matches the wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: A private static method that removes the wake word/alias from the input text.
